app.name: maewmeet
app.description: See which days your friends are all free, and make plans in one place.

login.title: Sign in
login.usernameHint: Lowercase letters, numbers, dots or underscores
login.notYet: Signing in isn’t available yet. This is a preview of the screen.

locked.title: Temporarily locked
locked.hint: While it’s locked, even the right PIN won’t work. If you’ve forgotten it, you can ask for a reset.
locked.long: Too many tries. Try again in {hours} h {minutes} min.

resetBanner.pending: Reset request sent. Waiting for an admin to approve it.
resetBanner.approved: Your reset was approved. Use the PIN 123456 on this device until {expires}.

home.title: No plans yet
home.body: Find a day when everyone’s free, then make a plan from it.

homeNoGroup.title: You’re not in a group yet
homeNoGroup.body: Start a group with your friends, then see which days work for everyone.
homeNoGroup.joinCode: Got an invite code? Enter it

calendar.title: No one’s added busy time this month
calendar.body: Add yours first so friends know when you’re tied up.

calendarNoGroup.title: No group calendar yet
calendarNoGroup.body: Join or create a group and the calendar will show when everyone’s free.

calendarSolo.title: It’s just you in this group
calendarSolo.body: Invite friends to see which days you’re all free.

groups.title: You’re not in a group yet
groups.body: Create a group, then bring friends in with an invite code.
groups.joinCode: Got an invite code? Enter it

me.title: Account settings aren’t here yet
me.body: You can change language and theme for now. Your name and PIN come after you sign in.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The link might be wrong, or the page has moved.

prefs.savedLocalOnly: Changed on this device, but we couldn’t save it to your account.

error.generic: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
error.network: Can’t connect. Check your connection and try again.

legend.title: What the colours mean
legend.countNote: Numbers show how many of the {total} members are free that day.

calendar.groupMissing: We couldn’t find that group, so we’re showing your first one instead.
calendar.truncated: This calendar has a lot of entries, so not all of them are shown. Try a shorter stretch.

groupSwitch.label: Switch group — viewing “{group}”
groupSwitch.title: Which group’s calendar?
groupSwitch.hint: Your busy time is the same in every group, so you only add it once.

cell.aria: {date}{today, select, yes {, today} other {}}{outside, select, yes {, outside this month} other {}}, {count, plural, =0 {nobody busy} one {1 person busy} other {# people busy}}

busyLegend.hint: Each dot is one member who’s busy that day. Tap a day for the times.
busyLegend.more: “+3” means 3 more people are busy that day.
busyLegend.sameColour: Groups over 10 people reuse colours. Each day’s list has the names.

day.summary: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody’s busy} one {1 of {total} is busy} other {# of {total} are busy}}

empty.title: {when, select, today {No one’s marked busy today} other {No one’s marked busy on this day}}
empty.body: Tied up that day? Add it so your friends know.

error.title: Couldn’t load the calendar
error.body: Check your connection and try again. The busy time you added is safe.

gone.title: You’re not in this group any more
gone.body: The group may have been deleted, or you were removed. Pick another group, or head back to Groups.

signup.title: Create an account
signup.intro: Sign in with a username and a 6-digit PIN. No email needed.
signup.usernameHint: 3–20 characters: a–z, numbers, dots or underscores
signup.displayNameHint: Friends in your groups see this name. Up to 40 characters, any language.
signup.pinRemember: Keep your PIN somewhere safe. There’s no email to recover it, so if you forget it an admin has to approve a reset.

pinChange.hintConfirm: Enter the same 6 digits once more

pinRules.title: What makes a valid PIN
pinRules.notRepeated: Not all the same digit, like 000000
pinRules.notSequence: Not a straight run, like 123456 or 654321
pinRules.why: That’s all it takes to rule out the easy guesses. Pick numbers you’ll remember but others won’t guess.

forgot.title: Forgot your PIN?
forgot.intro: Tell us your username. An admin will check the request and let you set a new PIN.
forgot.deviceNote: Once it’s approved, sign in from this device. If you switch devices or clear your browser data, this request won’t work and you’ll need to send a new one.

pending.title: Request sent
pending.body: An admin will review it, which can take a little while. If you remember your PIN in the meantime, just sign in as usual and the request is cancelled for you.
pending.hint: You can close this page and check back on the sign-in screen.
pending.expiry: If nobody answers within 7 days, the request expires and you can send a new one.

approved.title: Approved
approved.body: Sign in with your username and the PIN 123456, then set a new PIN right away.
approved.thisDevice: Works only on this device, the one you sent the request from.

closed.title: This request is closed
closed.body: It expired, was declined, or has already been used. You can send a new one.

setPin.title: Set a new PIN
setPin.intro: For your security, choose a new PIN before you carry on. 123456 can’t be used again.
setPin.doneOthers: Any other devices you were signed in on have been signed out.

adminResets.title: PIN reset requests
adminResets.warningTitle: Check with the owner before approving
adminResets.warningBody: Anyone who knows a username can ask for a reset in their name. Contact the owner outside the app, by chat or a call, and compare the time, device and country with what they tell you. If they don’t match, or they didn’t ask, decline.

approveSheet.title: Approve request from {username}
approveSheet.body: {username}’s PIN will become 123456 for 24 hours, on the device that sent the request only. Their old PIN stops working straight away.
approveSheet.check: I’ve confirmed with the account owner outside the app

rejectSheet.title: Decline request from {username}
rejectSheet.body: The request will be closed. Their current PIN keeps working.

empty.title: No requests waiting
empty.body: When someone taps Forgot PIN, their request shows up here.

me.title: Me
me.logoutAllHint: Signs you out on every device you’ve used, including this one.

logoutAllConfirm.title: Sign out everywhere?
logoutAllConfirm.body: You’ll need to sign in again on every device, this one included. Your current PIN still works.

pin.title: Change PIN
pin.done: PIN changed. Your other devices have been signed out.

help.admin: Can do everything in the group, including making moderators, handing over the admin role and deleting the group.
help.moderator: Can rename the group, set the free-time window and remove members.
help.member: Can add busy time, make plans and invite friends.

groups.title: Groups
groups.openAria: Open {name}, {count, plural, one {# member} other {# members}}

join.title: Join with an invite code
join.label: Invite code
join.hint: Ask someone in the group for it. Capitals and the dash are optional. Codes never use 0, O, 1, I or L, so nothing gets mixed up.

invites.title: Invites for you
invites.unavailable: This invite isn’t available any more. It may have expired or been withdrawn.

createSheet.title: New group
createSheet.name: Group name
createSheet.hint: Up to {max} characters. Everyone in the group sees this name.
createSheet.nameInvalid: A group name needs 1–{max} characters, with no invisible characters.
createSheet.role: You’ll be the admin of this group, and you can rename it later.

group.yourRole: {role, select, admin {You’re an admin} moderator {You’re a moderator} other {You’re a member}}

solo.title: It’s just you in this group
solo.body: Invite your friends first, then you can see which days work for everyone.

calendarSoon.title: The group calendar is on its way
calendarSoon.body: Soon you’ll see the days everyone’s free, right here. In the meantime, you can bring your friends in.

groupSettings.title: Group settings
groupSettings.memberNote: You’re a member, so group settings are view-only. You can still invite friends or leave.

window.title: Free-time window
window.body: Used to find days when everyone’s free. It takes effect once the group calendar is live.
window.summary: Only {start}–{end} counts, and we’ll show stretches when everyone’s free for at least {duration}.

members.title: Members and roles
members.transfer: Hand over admin to this person
members.roleChanged: {role, select, moderator {{name} is now a moderator} other {{name} is now a member}}

removeConfirm.title: Remove {name} from the group?
removeConfirm.body: {name} will lose access to this group straight away. They can come back if someone invites them again.

invite.title: Invite friends
invite.mineOnly: You only see the codes you created.

code.title: Invite codes
code.body: Send a code to a friend and ask them to enter it in the Groups tab. Anyone can use it until it expires or is revoked.
code.usedCount: {count, plural, =0 {Not used yet} one {Used by # person} other {Used by # people}}

revokeConfirm.title: Revoke the code ending {hint}?
revokeConfirm.body: Anyone who hasn’t used this code yet won’t be able to join with it. People who already joined aren’t affected.

sheet.title: New invite code
sheet.onceTitle: You’ll only see this code once
sheet.onceBody: Once you close this, the full code is gone for good. Copy or share it now. If you miss it, revoke it and make a new one.
sheet.shareText: Join “{group}” on maewmeet. Enter the code {code} in the Groups tab. It works until {expires}.

direct.title: Invite by username
direct.label: Friend’s username
direct.hint: Type their username, not their display name. They’ll see the invite in the Groups tab.
direct.alreadyInvited: You’ve already invited {username}. Waiting for their answer.

transfer.title: Hand over admin
transfer.body: Pick the member who will be the new admin. You’ll become a moderator.

confirm.title: Make {name} the admin?
confirm.body: {name} becomes the group’s admin and you become a moderator. You can’t undo this yourself. {name} would have to hand it back.

leave.title: Leave group
leave.body: You’ll lose access to this group’s calendar and plans. To come back, someone has to invite you again or you need an invite code.
leave.adminBlocked: You’re the admin of this group. Hand the admin role to someone else before you leave.

confirm.title: Leave “{group}”?
confirm.body: You’ll lose access to this group’s calendar and plans. To come back, someone has to invite you again or you need an invite code.

delete.title: Delete group
delete.body: Once deleted, nobody can open this group.

confirm.title: Delete “{group}”?
confirm.body: Everyone in the group loses access straight away, open invites and codes stop working, and you can’t bring the group back yourself.
confirm.typeLabel: Type the group name to confirm

pin_reset.approved: An admin approved your PIN reset request (valid until {expiresAt}).
pin_reset.cancelled_by_login: Your PIN reset request was cancelled because you signed in with your current PIN. If you didn’t send it, change your PIN in the Me tab.

errors.VALIDATION: Some fields need a fix. Check the highlighted ones and try again.
errors.NOT_FOUND: We couldn’t find that. It may have been deleted, or you’re no longer in that group.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You don’t have permission to do that. Ask a group admin if you think you should.
errors.CONFLICT: Someone changed this in the meantime. Reload to see the latest, then try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: That’s a lot at once. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.FEATURE_DISABLED: This is turned off for now. Try again later.
errors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
errors.AUTH_MAINTENANCE: Sign-in and sign-up are paused for maintenance. Your data is safe, and this won’t count as a wrong PIN. Try again later.
errors.ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED: This account is suspended. If you think that’s a mistake, contact the app admin.
errors.PIN_CHANGE_REQUIRED: Set a new PIN to continue.
errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Wrong username or PIN.{attemptsRemaining, plural, =0 {} =1 { One try left before a short lock.} other { # tries left.}}
errors.LOGIN_LOCKED: Too many tries. Try again in {retryAfterMin, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
errors.USERNAME_TAKEN: That username’s taken. Try another one.
errors.USERNAME_FORMAT: Usernames are 3–20 characters: a–z, 0–9, dots and underscores only.
errors.PIN_FORMAT: Your PIN needs to be exactly 6 digits, with no letters or spaces.
errors.PIN_MISMATCH: The PINs don’t match. Try again.
errors.PIN_TOO_WEAK: That PIN is easy to guess. All the same digit (like 000000) or a straight run (like 123456 or 654321) isn’t allowed. Try a different mix.
errors.CSRF_REJECTED: We couldn’t verify that request. Reload the page and try again.
errors.ADMIN_TRANSFER_REQUIRED: Make someone else the group admin first, then try again.
errors.INVITE_INVALID: This code doesn’t work. Ask someone in the group for a new one.
errors.ALREADY_MEMBER: That person’s already in this group.
errors.USER_NOT_FOUND: No one has that username. Check the spelling, or send them an invite code instead.
errors.LIMIT_REACHED: {limit, select, groups {You can create up to {max} groups. Delete one you no longer use to make a new one.} members {This group is full ({max} members at most). An admin can remove members who aren’t active.} codes {This group already has {max} active invite codes. Revoke one you don’t need to make a new one.} busyCount {You already have {max} upcoming busy entries, the most we allow. Delete ones you don’t need, then add this one.} busySpan {One entry can cover {max} days at most. Try splitting it into a few.} busyBackdate {You can add busy time up to {max} days back. Pick a more recent date.} other {You’ve hit a limit. Free something up and try again.}}
errors.INVALID_RANGE: {kind, select, dates {The last day can’t come before the first day.} other {The end has to be after the start.}}
errors.INVALID_DATE: That date doesn’t exist (like 30 February). Pick one from the calendar.
errors.INVALID_LOCAL_TIME: That time doesn’t exist here because the clocks skip ahead. Pick another time.
errors.TIME_NOT_ON_STEP: Times go in half-hour steps, like 18:00 or 18:30.
errors.DATE_OUT_OF_RANGE: That date is outside the range we support. Pick one from the calendar.
errors.RANGE_TOO_LARGE: That date range is too long. Try a shorter one.
errors.INVALID_TIMEZONE: We don’t recognise that time zone. Pick one from the list.
errors.INVALID_WINDOW: The group’s free-time hours don’t work. The end has to be after the start, and the window can’t be shorter than the minimum free stretch.
errors.INVALID_MAP_URL: We can’t read a location from that link. Try copying it from the Share button in your maps app.
errors.INVALID_COORDINATES: Those coordinates don’t look right. Check the latitude and longitude.
errors.APPOINTMENT_CANCELLED: This plan was cancelled, so it can’t be changed.

mine.title: My busy time
mine.lead: Add it once and friends in all your groups see the same thing.
mine.count: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing yet} one {1 upcoming entry} other {# upcoming entries}}
mine.truncated: You have a lot of entries, so not all of them are shown. Delete old ones you don’t need and try again.
mine.limitNear: You’re using {count} of {max} entries. Delete old ones you don’t need to free up space.

empty.title: No busy time coming up
empty.body: Add it ahead of time so friends don’t plan over it.

error.title: Couldn’t load your list
error.body: Check your connection and try again. Nothing you added is lost.

form.title: Add busy time

help.timed: Pick a start and end time. It can run past midnight.

date.label: Date
date.pickRange: Tap the first day, then the last
date.pickTimed: Tap the day. For several days, tap the last day too.

form.totalDays: {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} in total

hide.label: Hide what I’m doing
hide.help: Friends will only see “Busy”, not what you’re up to.

note.label: Private note
note.help: Only you can see this. Friends never do, even if you leave your description visible.

form.visibility: Friends in every group you’re in will see this time
form.visibilityGroups: {count, plural, one {That’s 1 group right now} other {That’s # groups right now}}

notice.title: Add it once — every group sees it
notice.body: Busy time you add shows to friends in all your groups, so there’s no need to repeat it for each one. To show only “Busy”, turn on Hide what I’m doing. The private note is for you alone.

error.save: Couldn’t save. What you typed is still here — try again.
error.gone: This entry no longer exists. It may have been deleted on another device.

delete.title: Delete this busy time?
delete.body: It disappears from every friend’s calendar right away, and you can’t undo it.
